figures.title: Concept of operations and the filtering of recognition opportunities
figures.alt: Diagram of how a live facial recognition deployment works, from camera to officer engagement, followed by an inverted funnel of filtering stages from a person walking towards the camera to action.
figures.source_title: Metropolitan Police Service Live Facial Recognition Trials (NPL report, Feb 2020)

figures.title: The Zone of Recognition
figures.alt: Perspective drawing of a camera and the three-dimensional zone in front of it where faces are in focus and at usable resolution.
figures.source_title: Metropolitan Police Service Live Facial Recognition Trials (NPL report, Feb 2020)

figures.title: Example of data collected per deployment (Romford)
figures.alt: Deployment sheet for Romford: crowd and watchlist ethnicity pie charts, outcome counts, a street layout with camera field of view, and example footage with faces blanked.
